name: Hero Valkyr's Calling deals its Holy damage on the charge-down, scaling with attack power (#7442)
contract: Valkyr's Calling 280650 tooltip (Spell.dbc Description[enUS]): 'leap into the air, becoming immune ... At the
end of the duration, you charge back down, dealing ${$280654m1+$280654ppl1+$AP*0.225+$SP*.225} Holy damage to
all enemies within $280654a1 yds.' The whole chain is native: 280650 Effect1 triggers the leap (280651,
LEAP_BACK), its Effect0 (ASCENSION_TRIGGER_SPELL_DELAYED) schedules 280652 after ~1.8s; 280652's Effect0
(JUMP_DEST) lands the caster and its Effect1 (delayed-trigger amplitude) fires 280654; 280654's Effect0 is a
plain SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE with EffectBasePoints[0]=123 (non-zero) and a non-zero area radius. The
expected non-zero, AP-scaling Holy hit is read from this DBC data and the tooltip formula, independent of
whether the reported zero-damage symptom is reproduced.

steps.label: Let the ~1.8 s airborne delay and the charge-down trigger chain complete
DISCRIMINATING: the charge-down's Holy damage actually lands on the target, not zero as reported
The landed hit deals non-zero Holy damage
